description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire], [Awoken Monk], [Damage Cap +10000], [Windborn Swiftness Mode] and [Windborn Swiftness 0] to the user

description.name: Awoken Monk
description.text: Monk abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Monk abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Windborn Swiftness 0
description.text: Grants [Windborn Swiftness 1] after using a Monk ability, removed if the character hasn't [Windborn Swiftness Mode]

description.name: Windborn Swiftness 1
description.text: Monk abilities deal 10% more damage, cast speed x2.00, grants [Windborn Swiftness 2] after using a Monk ability, removed if the character hasn't [Windborn Swiftness Mode]

description.name: Windborn Swiftness 2
description.text: Monk abilities deal 20% more damage, cast speed x3.00, grants [Windborn Swiftness 3] after using a Monk ability, removed if the character hasn't [Windborn Swiftness Mode]

description.name: Windborn Swiftness 3
description.text: Monk abilities deal 30% more damage, cast speed x4.00, grants [Windborn Swiftness 3] after using a Monk ability, removed if the character hasn't [Windborn Swiftness Mode]
